categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Expressway Company Limited primarily operates in the investment, construction, operation, and management of toll roads and bridges within Jiangsu Province, China. It also develops and operates ancillary service areas along expressways, including refueling and catering services. Additionally, the company is expanding into transportation+ and new energy businesses, including photovoltaic and wind power generation projects.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs intelligent toll collection systems, including toll collection robots and cloud-based free-flow tolling technology. It utilizes advanced road maintenance technologies such as in-situ thermal regeneration, chip seal technology, and low-carbon materials like seam tape and pouring sealant. The company also integrates digital and intelligent transportation systems, including UAV-based road inspections and smart energy management systems for real-time monitoring and optimization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are individual vehicle users including passenger and freight vehicles using the toll roads and bridges. The company also serves ancillary service area customers, including retail and catering consumers. Its new energy business serves the regional power grid and related infrastructure. The major markets are within Jiangsu Province, particularly the economically vibrant Yangtze River Delta region.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Jiangsu Province, China, focusing on the Yangtze River Delta region. It manages key expressways and bridges linking major cities such as Shanghai, Suzhou, Wuxi, Changzhou, Zhenjiang, and Nanjing. It also has overseas-listed shares and an ADR program in the United States but its operations are principally domestic.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Expressway Company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the transportation infrastructure supply chain, focusing on the operation and management of toll roads and bridges. It also engages in upstream activities through investment and construction of infrastructure projects and new energy generation facilities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation, low-carbon transition, and high-quality development. It focuses on intelligent expressway expansion, digital transformation, and integration of transportation with energy systems. R&D efforts include developing intelligent toll collection, smart maintenance technologies, and photovoltaic power generation standards. The company also emphasizes green and low-carbon technologies and aims to build zero-carbon service areas.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly from toll collections on expressways and bridges, accounting for over 40% of total revenue and over 77% excluding construction income. Ancillary services such as leasing, retail, and catering in service areas contribute additional revenue. The new energy segment generates revenue from electricity sales. The company also earns investment income from equity investments and dividends.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jiangsu Expressway Company is the only listed road and bridge company in Jiangsu Province and holds a dominant position in the southern Jiangsu expressway network. It is recognized for its high-quality assets, leading operational concepts, and strong market image. The company maintains a leading position in the expressway industry within its region, supported by a professional management team and comprehensive risk management.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of the end of 2024, the company reported total assets of approximately RMB89.886 billion and net assets attributable to shareholders of RMB38.597 billion. Operating revenue increased by 52.7% year-on-year to RMB23.198 billion, driven mainly by construction revenue. Net profit attributable to shareholders grew by 12.09% to RMB4.947 billion. The company maintains a stable cash flow and a weighted average return on equity of 13.63%, with a decreasing gearing ratio indicating improved financial health.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company leverages its unique geographic advantage in the economically vibrant Yangtze River Delta and operates a high-quality network of expressways and bridges that are critical transport corridors. It differentiates itself through advanced intelligent toll collection systems, integrated transportation-energy solutions, and commitment to green and low-carbon development. Its professional management, strong financing platforms, and comprehensive risk management further enhance its competitive edge and sustainable growth potential.
